title: Corner ribbon on a card
summary: An absolute tag pinned to the card's top-right corner, clipped by overflow: hidden.
explanation: The card is position: relative, so the ribbon is placed against its corner. top: 0 and right: 0 pin it flush with the top-right edge, and the padding on the ribbon keeps its text clear of the border.
overflow: hidden clips anything that reaches past the card's rounded corners. The ribbon's own corner gets a radius, and the card clips the rest. z-index: 1 keeps the ribbon above the card's content.
tryThis: Remove position: relative from .card: the ribbon jumps to the top-right of the preview.
Remove overflow: hidden and widen the ribbon with padding: the corner shape breaks out of the card.
Set top: 24px to drop the ribbon below the card's edge.
